svg.title: Tank-G front panel mapped to openvave fields
svg.desc: The Tank-G front panel in panel order. Above each of the fifteen knobs, a badge with its preset byte and its openvave field name, coloured like the knob LED: master (not mapped), ir_cab 17, reverb_mix 16, reverb_decay 15, delay_time 14, delay_mix 13, mod_speed 12, mod_fx 11, volume 10, bass 9, middle 8, treble 7, gain 6, amp_type 5, noise_gate 4. Below, the footswitches A/REVERB (slot A, reverb_on byte 3), B/DELAY (slot B, delay_on 2), C/MOD (slot C, mod_on 1), D/AMP (slot D, amp_on 0).
svg.text: Each badge is the control's byte in the 21-byte preset (openvave preset dump); colours follow the knob LEDs.
read right to left: preset bytes 4 → 17
Original drawing traced from the owner's pedal; not a vendor image.
